verdict.rationale: Authenticator is a credential and TOTP vault app, so programmatic entry creation is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows only manual in-app flows: QR scanning, manual account add, cloud backup, and manual password export and import. No documented API, CLI or SDK lets an agent seed TOTP secrets or store credentials, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
